name: RustFS 1.0.4
body:
This patch updates certificate verification and bundled trust roots, removes the distrusted emSign ECC Root CA - G3 from container trust stores, and retains the dependency refresh.

## What's Changed
* chore(deps): refresh dependencies and pin Pulsar 6.9.0 by @houseme in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/8923
* fix(test): backport scanner wait correction for 1.0.4 by @overtrue in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/8930


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/compare/1.0.3...1.0.4
